story_text: Yesterday, I sat on my bed and played Minecraft on my computer. I wanted to build a big castle. My dog Niuniu came into my room. She was quiet at first, but then she barked twice. I did not stop, so she pushed my leg with her nose and made more noise. I felt bad, so I closed the game. Instead, I took Niuniu to the garden and threw her ball. She ran fast and brought it back to me. We played for thirty minutes. After that, I went back to my room and finished my castle. I was happy because I played with Niuniu and finished my game, too.

comprehension_questions: What did the boy want to build in Minecraft?
What did Niuniu do to get the boy's attention?
Why did the boy stop playing Minecraft?
Do you think Niuniu was happy in the garden? What in the story makes you think so?
speaking_questions: Does Niuniu (or another pet you know) ever try to get your attention? What does she do?
What do you like to build in Minecraft?
Have you ever stopped doing one thing to do something else instead? What did you do?

writing_task.prompt: Write 3 sentences about a time you played with Niuniu, a pet, or a toy. Say what happened first, what happened next, and how you felt.

parent_observation: 朗读时能否流畅读出 castle / bark / twice / instead / throw 这几个生词，发音是否准确。
回答口语问题时能否用完整句子描述和宠物/玩具互动的经历，而不是只说单词。
写作三句话是否主动使用过去时（如 played, threw, felt），而不是习惯性用现在时描述过去的事。
对'我的世界'和金毛犬niuniu这个话题是否表现出兴趣，是否愿意多说几句。
